title: A site rendered per request has a sitemap
why: A site with no prerendered indexable page served an empty /sitemap.xml: the origin came from the static file and per-request pages were never listed.
changelog: `/sitemap.xml` takes the origin from the manifest and lists public pages rendered per request, as does llms.txt
B1900 stops a build whose sitemap would list no URL; `brain seo audit --url` reports it on a live site
